content:
Fiera Real Estate UK and the Universities Superannuation Scheme have announced a new joint venture targeting urban industrial and logistics development across the UK. The platform will focus on small to mid box schemes in supply constrained locations, responding to continued occupier demand for modern, well located industrial space.


The strategy targets brownfield and established employment sites, with individual investments of up to £50 million and an initial five year investment horizon. Two South East sites are already under offer, with a combined gross development value exceeding £100 million.


The joint venture reflects sustained institutional confidence in UK industrial real estate, underpinned by long term structural demand, urban logistics growth, and a continued emphasis on high quality, sustainable assets.
